messages:
paul-partnerships: Heads up — Marketplace partner CloudMart is rejecting POs flagged for non-resident withholding. Their gateway wants an explicit `withholding_tax=true|false` field and a tax-rate code. We're sending legacy POs without that and they're going into a hold state.

seb-sales: this is blocking two channel deals in LATAM. partner ops says finance will withhold 10% if field not present. need fix asap.

paul-partnerships: example payload they rejected: `{"po_id":"CM-2026-334", "amount":5000, "seller":{"id":"reseller-44","country":"BR"}}` error: `422 Unprocessable Entity - missing_withholding_flag`.

linda-tax: this sounds like a withholding/regime change in Brazil. we need to ensure our PO flow can include a `withholding` object: `{"withholding_tax":true, "tax_code":"BR-WHT-10"}` and record who bears withholding (buyer/seller). Also need doc proving seller tax status.

own-ops: platform currently maps tax fields from partner profile but doesn't emit a specific withholding flag. small change to PO formatter should do it. we can add default `withholding_tax=false` and allow partner integration to override. ETA: staging in 6 hours, prod after approvals.

claire-legal: legal note: if withholding is applied, contracts must reflect net vs gross payment responsibilities. we have a redline in some reseller MSAs about tax gross-up. if we automatically set withholding=false we might be out of compliance in some jurisdictions. recommend mapping by seller country + tax profile.

paul-partnerships: can procurement/tax provide a decision matrix? i can also ask CloudMart what they expect per country to avoid churn.

linda-tax: quick matrix (draft): BR -> default withholding true (10%); MX -> depends on treaty -> need seller tax cert; US/EU -> false. we'll push final table in 2 hours.

marketplace-bot: automated: PO CM-2026-334 rejected by cloudmart-gateway: missing_withholding_flag (request id 7f2a9b).

seb-sales: partner ops demands a written confirmation we will include the flag. can we ship a hotfix that emits `withholding_tax` (default false) and a follow-up config to set per-seller overrides?

own-ops: yes. plan: 1) add `withholding_tax` and `tax_code` fields to outbound PO json with default false; 2) extend seller profile service to store `withholding_override` and `tax_rate_code`; 3) deploy feature-flag `po.withholding_flag` to staging. staging ETA 6h, prod ~24h after smoke/tests and legal signoff.

claire-legal: i need to review the seller profile schema change and add a clause to the partner onboarding checklist requiring tax certificates where withholding might apply. i'll add that to the MSA addendum draft.

linda-tax: once patch is on staging, i'll run a small suite of regional cases (BR/MX/AR) to confirm residual withholding is correct. will post results.

paul-partnerships: thanks — i'll message CloudMart with a conservative timeline and ask them to accept POs into a `pending-tax-info` queue so funds aren't trapped but deals can progress.

seb-sales: perfect. please include sample payload and note that we'll include audit logs of original and modified POs. partner wanted an audit trail.

marketplace-bot: deploy pipeline: feature branch po/withholding-flag created. CI queued.

paul-partnerships: great work team. update thread when staging link is up and legal/tax confirm the matrix. :thumbsup:
